title: 第25章 镖局回归数十具匪徒尸体震动全城第26章 两百缕气血
slug: 满级武圣从绝世神功开始
content_zh:
宴席正常举办。
张宿被叫到了主桌，与大哥以及一众府城有头有脸的大人物坐在一起。
虽然张宿沉默寡言，但大哥张辰却是能说会道。
而且，不知道是不是错觉。
张宿发现大哥的腰似乎都挺直了。
到了下午，张辰已经喝得醉醺醺的。
但他却很高兴。
“二弟，哈哈哈，我二弟是武道天才……”
嫂子看到张辰这副模样，并没有责怪，反而忍俊不禁。
她看着张宿，笑着说道：“二弟，你看看你大哥，这是真高兴啊，平日里几乎不喝酒，今天却喝了这么多……”
张宿点了点头。
他也能看出来，大哥的确是发自内心的高兴。
就在这时，外面忽然传来了一阵喧闹声。
而且声音越来越大。
苏蓁蓁眉头一皱。
“小翠，去看看外面是什么情况？”
“是，小姐。”
于是，小翠迅速朝着外面走去。
外面的声音并没有减弱。
还夹杂着一些惊呼声。

张宿感知敏锐。
可声音太嘈杂了。
他也就隐约听到什么“镖局”“尸体”之类的声音。
没过多久，小翠快步跑了回来。
她神情还很激动。
“小姐、姑爷，是镇远镖局的人回来了……”
“而且，镇远镖局的车上，还载着数十具尸体，那场面，真是吓人。我打听了一下，那些尸体据说是什么飞天岭的匪徒，非常凶恶，在江湖上名声不小……”
随着小翠的详细解释，众人也都知道发生了什么情况。
“什么，飞天岭匪徒？”
原本有些醉醺醺的张辰，听到“飞天岭”时，似乎也一下子清醒了过来。
他急忙问道：“货物，镖局押送的货物怎么样了？”
小翠仔细想了想：“货物似乎没什么损失，那些人都在议论李总镖头武功高强，连那什么飞天岭大当家都给杀了……”
张辰闻言松了口气。
不过，张宿听到这里，表情却有些古怪。
李贺杀了何雄飞？
镇远镖局灭了飞天岭？
不过，张宿已经把飞天岭众匪的尸体都给了镇远镖局。
对方也给了两千两银子。
那镇远镖局怎么宣传，也与他无关。
何况，这些虚名，对张宿也没什么用。

因此，张宿安静地坐着，没有说话。
可张辰却坐不住了。
镇远镖局押送的那批货可太重要了。
“不行，我得去看看。”
content_en:
The banquet will be held as normal.
Zhang Su was called to the main table and sat with his eldest brother and other prominent figures in the city.
Although Zhang Su is taciturn, his eldest brother Zhang Chen is eloquent.
And, I don’t know if it’s an illusion.
Zhang Su found that his eldest brother's waist seemed to be straightened.
By the afternoon, Zhang Chen was already drunk.
But he was happy.
"Second brother, hahaha, my second brother is a martial arts genius..."
When my sister-in-law saw Zhang Chen's appearance, she didn't blame him, but couldn't help laughing.
She looked at Zhang Su and said with a smile: "Second brother, look at your elder brother, he is so happy. He hardly drinks alcohol on weekdays, but he drank so much today..."
Zhang Su nodded.
He could also see that the eldest brother was indeed happy from the bottom of his heart.
At this moment, there was a sudden noise outside.
And the sound is getting louder and louder.
Su Zhenzhen frowned.
"Xiao Cui, go see what's going on outside?"
"Yes, miss."
So, Xiaocui quickly walked outside.
The sounds outside did not subside.
There were also some exclamations mixed in.
Zhang Su's perception is sharp.
But the sound was too noisy.
He also vaguely heard sounds like "escort agency" and "corpse".
Not long after, Xiaocui ran back quickly.
She looked very excited.
"Miss, uncle, someone from the Zhenyuan Escort Agency is back..."
"Moreover, the Zhenyuan Escort Bureau's car was carrying dozens of corpses. The scene was really scary. I inquired about it and found out that those corpses were said to be gangsters from Feitian Ridge. They were very vicious and had a good reputation in the world..."
With Xiaocui's detailed explanation, everyone knew what happened.
"What, Feitianling bandits?"
Zhang Chen, who was a little drunk at first, seemed to suddenly wake up when he heard "Feitian Ridge".
He hurriedly asked: "What happened to the goods, the goods escorted by the escort?"
Xiao Cui thought about it carefully: "There seems to be no damage to the goods. Those people are talking about Mr. Li's martial arts skills, and even the leader of Feitian Ridge was killed..."
Zhang Chen breathed a sigh of relief after hearing this.
However, when Zhang Su heard this, his expression was a little strange.
Li He killed He Xiongfei?
Zhenyuan Escort Bureau destroyed Feitian Ridge?
However, Zhang Su had already given the bodies of the Feitian Ridge bandits to the Zhenyuan Escort Bureau.
The other party also gave him two thousand taels of silver.
How the Zhenyuan Escort Bureau promotes it has nothing to do with him.
What's more, these false names are of no use to Zhang Su.
Therefore, Zhang Su sat quietly without speaking.
But Zhang Chen couldn't sit still.
The batch of goods escorted by the Zhenyuan Escort Bureau is too important.
"No, I have to go take a look."
